intent.proves: Feeds: feeds-incomplete satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(FeedId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + CAST(FeedName AS nvarchar(200)) FROM EcomFeed WHERE ISNULL(FeedIsFolder, 0) = 0 AND (ISNULL(FeedProvider, N'') = N'' OR ISNULL(FeedLanguageIds, N'') = N'' OR (ISNULL(FeedIndexQueryId, N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(FeedChannelId, N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(CAST(FeedProductsAndGroups AS nvarchar(max)), N'') = N'' AND ISNULL(FeedShopIds, N'') = N''))
